top_signals.title: Korea Bears Brunt as Higher Bond Yields Weigh on Chip Stocks
top_signals.summary: South Korea led a selloff in Asian chip stocks early Wednesday, as rising bond yields exacerbated worry over the large sums of cash being shelled out by Big Tech.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Israeli airstrikes hit Syrian airbase, drawing Turkish condemnation
top_signals.summary: Tom Barrack, the U.S. ambassador to Turkey and special envoy for Syria and Iraq, called the strikes an "unnecessary escalation."
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
